answer: The island is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the dawn. The design leans on time-locked work history, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the tundra of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
